summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime to execute obfuscated bundled payload
details: The npm preinstall hook runs setup.mjs, which downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases (v1.3.13), extracts it to a temp directory, chmods the binary executable, and invokes it against the package-local file math_init.js. math_init.js is a ~727KB single-line obfuscated Bun bundle using a rotated string-array shifter and mangled identifiers, unrelated to the package's declared Slack/Teams channel-transformer purpose. setup.mjs itself is hex-identifier obfuscated (_0x488df8, _0x52943e,...) with property-lookup dispatcher objects wrapping every execFileSync, https.get, fs.chmodSync, and fs.writeFileSync call. Bun is being used solely to execute sibling package code in a runtime most Node-based scanners do not inspect; the obfuscated payload's behavior cannot be examined from the Node side. On npm install, the fetch-and-execute of the concealed payload runs automatically.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
